# Security policy

## Supported versions

Tea Project is in maintenance mode. Security fixes are considered for the latest revision on `main`; older revisions and historical deployments are not supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/derekdylu/tea-project/security/advisories/new) to report a suspected vulnerability. Do not include credentials, exploit details, or personal data in a public issue.

Include the affected revision, impact, reproduction conditions, and any suggested mitigation. Use synthetic data and redact secrets. The maintainers will assess reports as availability permits; this legacy project does not offer a response-time guarantee.
